column1: # The phrases a brief, a ticket, a pull request body, a review or a hand-back may not hold.
# One line each, fields separated by tabs: a label, a pattern, an example the pattern matches
# (tested), and what to do instead. A line that starts with # is not a phrase.
# The pattern language is small: a character, \s \d \w, \b (a word edge), \<c> (the
# character c), a class [...] or [^...] of characters and \s \d \w, and ? + * after an
# atom other than \b. No group and no alternation: an alternative is a line of its own.
